title: Updated Nationally Determined Contribution of the Republic of Uzbekistan
organization: Government of the Republic of Uzbekistan; UNFCCC repository
temporal_coverage: Historical warming since the early 1950s; NDC adaptation planning through 2030 and projections through 2050.
methodology: Government NDC with interagency climate and adaptation planning.
limitations: Official assessment; not an implementation evaluation.

title: Climate Action Could Accelerate Growth and Improve Living Standards in Uzbekistan: World Bank Group Report
temporal_coverage: CCDR release gives population risk estimates to 2030 and economic projection to 2050.
methodology: World Bank Group press-release summary of the Uzbekistan Country Climate and Development Report.
limitations: Only the official release was inspected; it does not reproduce all report model assumptions or uncertainty ranges.
